fato_historico: 1993: An American attack against a warlord in Mogadishu fails; eighteen US soldiers and over 350 Somalis die.
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to reflect on the nature of persistence and compassion. Just as history teaches us that even the most intense conflicts can be transformed into lessons of peace, you may find that gentle strength overcomes obstacles better than force. Consider how your steady Taurus nature can nurture healing connections and bring stability to your surrounding environment today.
frase_do_dia: True strength is found in the quiet resolve of a peaceful heart.
significado_numero: A cycle of closing old chapters to welcome new, brighter beginnings.
conselho: Practice patience with others and cultivate peace within your own heart today.
